title: Humo is the bird of happiness, and we are your travel companion
story: In Uzbek folklore, Humo is a bird whose wing's shadow brings happiness to whoever it falls upon. We chose the name on purpose: our goal is to make travel carefree, joyful and memorable. Route, stay, transport and guide — we prepare it all, so all that's left for you is to enjoy the road.

values.item_1_text: We welcome every guest as if they were coming home
values.item_2_text: Open prices, clear promises and no surprise charges
values.item_3_text: We build routes around your wishes, not around a template
values.item_4_text: In touch during the trip and after it

cta_title: Shall we choose your next trip together?
cta_subtitle: Browse the tours — you're sure to find one you love
